teaser: A pickup game breaks up slow, nobody wants to be the one who leaves first. You are a life path 3 and an ENFP, and that reluctance to let the room go quiet sits close to the center of what this crossing is. The 3 asks for expression, out loud, to other people; the ENFP already talks in possibilities and half-finished stories. Put the two in one person and the hard part is not finding something to say. It is picking which thread to follow when four are open at once, and letting one of them run long enough to mean something.
